description: This Java class implements an authentication handler for JWT tokens within the mockserver framework. It manages JWT validation, including initialization with JWK sources, and handles authentication requests by inspecting HTTP headers.

classes.name: JWTAuthenticationHandler
classes.description: Handles JWT authentication by validating tokens from HTTP requests, supporting configuration of expected audience, claims, and required claims.

methods.name: JWTAuthenticationHandler
methods.description: Constructor that initializes JWT validator with a JWK source, which can be a URL or a file path.

methods.name: withExpectedAudience
methods.description: Sets the expected audience claim for JWT validation.

methods.name: withMatchingClaims
methods.description: Configures matching claims for JWT validation.

methods.name: withRequiredClaims
methods.description: Specifies required claims for JWT validation.

methods.name: controlPlaneRequestAuthenticated
methods.description: Authenticates an HTTP request by validating its JWT token in the Authorization header.

methods.name: logAuthorisationFailure
methods.description: Logs authorization failure details and throws an AuthenticationException.
